race.description: Rosevale Angus Country Boosted Mdn Hcp
race.comment: HEATHCLIFF (1) well-bred Snitzel gelding who returned for his second prep with a closing third over 1200m at Scone. Fitter now and will relish the firmer surface. Expected to go close. DON'T SAY DO (7) comes back in trip and gets in light with the 3kg claimer engaged. Raced keenly with a fading sixth over 1450m at Quirindi in the soft (7) going. Will roll forward again and can finish much closer today. FLAUNTER (6) has impressed in all three career runs and better placed over this extra trip. Went back from the wide gate and launched late with a solid third over 1000m at Scone. Assess on the good second two-back over the 1300m at Scone. Value contender. FINAL PRETENCE (3) Menari mare from Pretentious Miss on debut for the Wes Boyd yard. Trialled okay and goes into the exotics.
